title: A generalization of the Fredenhagen-Haag derivation of Hawking radiation for a class of Vaidya space-times
summary: We develop a quantitative Fredenhagen--Haag like approach for describing Hawking radiation using massless scalar fields on controlled spherically symmetric Vaidya space-times. The local thermal character of the system is supplied by the universal scaling limit of Hadamard two-point functions at an outer trapping horizon \cite{KurpiczPinamontiVerch2021}. On regular detector--horizon windows, we construct globally hyperbolic developments and compare the nonautonomous Vaidya evolution with a frozen Schwarzschild propagator on Sobolev energy spaces.
